definitions.explanation: A formal expression using numbers, variables, and mathematical symbols to represent a relationship or calculation.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{数式|すうしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解|と}いて→解く：02301_toku⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧な{数式|すうしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦コンピュータ→コンピュータ：01992_konpyuuta⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{計算|けいさん}した→計算する：25526_keisansuru⟧。
examples.english: I calculated the complex formula using a computer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{物理学|ぶつりがく}→物理学：09631_butsurigaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{自然現象|しぜんげんしょう}→自然現象：24467_shizengenshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{数式|すうしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: In physics, natural phenomena are often expressed using mathematical formulas.

notes:
{数式|すうしき} refers to any mathematical expression or formula, from simple arithmetic to complex equations. It combines ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number) and {式|しき} (expression, formula).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数式|すうしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧ (solve an equation)
- {数式|すうしき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{立|た}てる→立てる：01196_tateru⟧ (set up an equation)
- {数式|すうしき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{表|あらわ}す→表す：01868_arawasu⟧ (express in a formula)
- {数式|すうしき}⟦{処理|しょり}→処理：03251_shori⟧ (formula processing)
- ⟦{複雑|ふくざつ}→複雑：01115_fukuzatsu⟧な{数式|すうしき} (complex formula)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{方程式|ほうていしき}→方程式：04795_houteishiki⟧: equation (specifically an equation with unknowns to solve)
- ⟦{公式|こうしき}→公式：04167_koushiki⟧: formula (an established, standard formula)
- {算式|さんしき}: arithmetic expression (simpler calculations)
- {数式|すうしき} is the most general term, covering all types of mathematical expressions

DOMAIN:
Used in mathematics, science, and computing contexts. The compound {数式|すうしき}エディタ (formula editor) is common in software.
